title: Select HTTPS while direct TLS is unavailable (Experimental)
goal: Use ordinary socket HTTPS when the direct-TLS documentation is withdrawn and the independently published package cannot supply its former endpoint API.

selectionNotes: GA documentation removed the direct-TLS include; NuGet index offers only RC1, not 11.0.0. RC1 lacks the former documented DirectTlsEndpoint. Current canonical code is ordinary socket HTTPS, not a direct-TLS implementation. Linux/OpenSSL transport selection and negotiation remain not-tested under the native policy. Actual supported direct-TLS artifact/scenario availability remains a PIN-967 stable-gate condition.
